title: Quartetti de Boccherini
institution: Bibliothèque nationale de France, département Musique, VMB MS-153
gerard_established_by: Confirmed against RISM. The prior-pass filename read 'Op. 22 - 4, 2, 6, 3', and RISM's four constituent records run Quartetto I = G186, II = G184, III = G188, IV = G185 -- Op. 22 nos. 4, 2, 6, 3, the same works in the same order.
parts_note: Gallica's ark serves only the violoncello part-book -- its manifest has 42 canvases, 'plat sup.' to 'plat inf.', and the record reads '4 parties ... Nombre total de vues : 42'. The other three part-books came from an earlier pass and are no longer findable on Gallica under this shelfmark; they are 1024x1536 PDFs, lower resolution than the jpg run.
rism_constituents_note: RISM 840022737 is a fifth item in the same volume -- 'Quartetto Terzo | A Due Violini Viola, e Basso | Bochni', also GerB 188. Two records therefore carry G 188; whether that is a duplicate record or a second copy of the work bound in is not established here. It accounts for the '(1-5)' in the cover shelfmark.

page_index.source: sequential filenames; order is preserved by the PDF
